sol-2-1.summary: Numeric brace-range expansion can append forever when floating-point addition does not advance, despite a member count within the expansion budget.
sol-2-1.fix: Bound sequence generation by the validated member count; reject non-finite computed counts through the typed expansion-budget guard before entering the loop, retaining positive-Infinity measurements and avoiding NaN schema defects. Preserve ordinary sequence order, increments and padding. Add large-singleton, non-advancing-endpoint and overflowing-arithmetic regressions in braceExpansion.test.ts and hostility.test.ts, and verify typed termination through both facade test files. Central deviation bookkeeping remains outside this group's write surface.
